P.name: Crimson Curse
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Briar's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|abilities}} inflict a bleed against enemies for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications, {{tip|stack|stacking}} up to 5 times and dealing {{ap|0.25*100}}% damage for stacks beyond the first. The bleed deals{{ft|{{as|{{pplevel|10 to 50}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''total''' physical damage}} and {{tip|heals}} '''Briar''' for {{pplevel|(10 to 50)*0.25|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.25}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} over the duration, increased by {{as|{{pplevel|10*0.25 to 50*0.25}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.25}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} and {{pplevel|(10*0.25 to 50*0.25)*0.25|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.25*0.25}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} for each subsequent stack respectively and up to a maximum of {{as|{{pplevel|10*{{#var:i_maxd}} to 50*{{#var:i_maxd}}}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*{{#var:i_maxd}}}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''total''' physical damage}} and {{pplevel|(10*{{#var:i_maxd}} to 50*{{#var:i_maxd}})*0.25|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*{{#var:i_maxd}}*0.25}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} over the duration.|{{as|{{pplevel|10/(5/0.5) to 50/(5/0.5)}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50/(5/0.5)}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|heals}} '''Briar''' for {{pplevel|(10/(5/0.5) to 50/(5/0.5))*0.25|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(50/(5/0.5)*0.25)}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds, increased by {{as|{{pplevel|10*0.25/(5/0.5) to 50*0.25/(5/0.5)}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.25/(5/0.5)}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} and {{pplevel|(10*0.25/(5/0.5) to 50*0.25/(5/0.5))*0.25|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(50*0.25/(5/0.5))*0.25}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} for each subsequent stack respectively and up to a maximum of {{as|{{pplevel|10*{{#var:i_maxd}}/(5/0.5) to 50*{{#var:i_maxd}}/(5/0.5)}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*{{#var:i_maxd}}/(5/0.5)}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|physical damage}} and {{pplevel|(10*{{#var:i_maxd}}/(5/0.5) to 50*{{#var:i_maxd}}/(5/0.5))*0.25|color=heal}}  {{as|(+ {{ap|(50*{{#var:i_maxd}}/(5/0.5))*0.25}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} per tick.}}If a target dies while bleeding, she will heal herself equal to 125% <!--pre or post mitigation?--> of the remaining bleed damage.
P.description2: '''Briar''' has no {{sti|health regeneration|{{as|'''base''' health regeneration}}}}, but she increases healing from all sources by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type='''missing''' health|0 to 40 for 11|0 to 100|formula=0.4% per 1% missing health}}|health}} {{as|(+ {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type='''missing''' health|0 to 2.5 for 11|0 to 100|formula=0.025% per 1% missing health}}|health}} per 100 '''bonus''' health)}}.

Q.name: Head Rush
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Briar''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target unit. If the target is an enemy, she deals {{as|physical damage}}, applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects, triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects, {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for {{fd|0.85}} seconds, and reduces their {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance}}}} for 5 seconds.
Q.description2: ''Head Rush {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Briar's''' basic attack timer.''
Q.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|60 to 160}} {{as|(+ 80% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
{{st|Resistances Reduction|{{ap|10 to 20}}%}}

W.name: Blood Frenzy
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Briar''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction. If there is a nearby enemy upon her arrival, she gains ''Blood Frenzy'' for 5 seconds, during which she can cast ''{{ai|Snack Attack|Briar}}''.
W.description2: {{sbc|Blood Frenzy:}} '''Briar''' breaks free from her pillory, causing her to become {{tt|forced|See notes}} to basic attack the nearest enemy. She {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} the target and gains {{tip|ghosting}}, {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, as well as empowering her basic attacks to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies surrounding her target. This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
W.description3: '''Briar''' prioritizes attacking {{tip|champions}}, then large {{tip|monsters}} or {{tip|minions}}, and then any other unit. If she casts ''{{ai|Head Rush|Briar}}'' on a non-champion, she will shift her target priority to large monsters or minions, then champions, and then any other unit.
W.description4: ''Blood Frenzy causes '''Briar''' to become unable to receive movement and attack commands. The frenzy ends early if there are no longer any nearby valid targets or {{ai|Chilling Scream|Briar}} is cast. Blood Frenzy {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Briar's''' basic attack timer. {{ai|Head Rush|Briar}} and {{ai|Certain Death|Briar}} can be cast during the dash.''

W.name: Snack Attack
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Briar''' empowers her next basic attack within 5 seconds during ''{{ai|Blood Frenzy|Briar}}'' to take a bite out of the target enemy, gaining {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}}, dealing {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{tip|heal|healing}} her for {{as|5% of her '''maximum''' health}} plus a percentage of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|5 to 65}} {{as|(+ 5% AD)}} {{as|(+ 9% {{as|(+ {{fd|2.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''missing''' health)}}}}
{{st|Heal Percentage|{{ap|24 to 40}}%}}
W.description2: ''Snack Attack'' deals 110% damage against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}, with the damage based on the target's health ratio being capped at 400.
W.leveling2: {{st|Non-Champion Bonus Damage|{{ap|5*1.1 to 65*1.1}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*1.1}}% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|9*1.1}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|2.5*1.1}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''missing''' health)}}}}
W.description3: ''Snack Attack {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Briar's''' basic attack timer.''

E.name: Chilling Scream
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Briar''' prepares to unleash a scream in the target direction, {{tip|channel|charging}} for up to 1 second, during which she increases ''Chilling Scream's'' damage and range, and gains 35% damage reduction and {{tip|heal|heals}} herself every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
E.leveling: {{st|Heal Per Tick|{{as|{{ap|10/4 to 16/4}}% '''maximum''' health}}|Maximum Heal|{{as|{{ap|10 to 16}}% '''maximum''' health}}}}
E.description2: ''Chilling Scream'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards. ''Chilling Scream's'' charge cannot be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} by {{tip|crowd control}}.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Briar''' unleashes the scream in the direction she targeted at the time of cast, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 80% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
E.description4: If ''Chilling Scream'' was charged for its full duration, enemies hit are also {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} 575 units. If they collide with terrain, they will rebound to take {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} and become {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.

R.name: Certain Death
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Briar''' kicks her pillory's hemolith in the target direction, briefly granting {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Can grant sight of area into brush and through terrain}} as it {{tt|travels|creates vision bubbles every 0.25 seconds}} and marking the first enemy champion hit as her prey. The mark's application {{tip|disrupt|disrupts}} the target's ongoing {{tip|channel|channels}}. While the target is marked, they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
R.description2: If a target is hit, '''Briar''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} herself from all {{tip|crowd control}} and becomes {{tip|cc-immune|immune to them}} over a cast time, afterwards {{tip|dash|dashing}} to them with {{tip|displacement immunity}}. Upon arrival, she creates an explosion around the marked target that deals {{as|magic damage}} to them and nearby enemies and {{tip|flee|fears}} all non-marked targets for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 35%. She then enters a state of ''Hematomania''.
R.description3: {{sbc|Hematomania:}} '''Briar''' gains all effects of ''{{ai|Blood Frenzy|Briar}}'' as well as {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} equal to {{as|20% AD}}, {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}, and {{sti|ms|{{as|'''additional bonus''' movement speed|ms}}}}.
R.leveling3:
{{st|Life Steal|{{ap|10 to 20}}%}}
{{st|Additional Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|10 to 30}}%}}
R.description4: While in the empowered frenzy, '''Briar''' prioritizes attacking the marked target over all other units and regardless of range. If that target becomes invalid, she will shift back to her {{tt|normal targeting priority|nearest non-marked champion, then large monster or minion, and then any other unit}} until the marked target can be attacked again. ''Hematomania'' lasts until the mark is dispelled by any means, including '''Briar's''' or the target's death.
R.description5: ''Casting {{ai|Chilling Scream|Briar}} removes the target's mark and ends Hematomania early. {{ais|Head Rush|Briar}} cast does not shift her targeting priority during Hematomania.''
R.cast time: {{dv|{{tt|1|Time before kicking hemolith}}|{{tt|{{fd|1.25}}|Time before dashing to target}}}}
